description.zh: 零依赖 Go 语言 Word 文档处理引擎,比主流 Python 方案快 21 倍。支持 18 种预定义样式与完整 OOXML。
description.en: Zero-dependency Go engine for Word docs, 21× faster than the Python path. 18 built-in styles, full OOXML coverage.

highlights.zh: 零依赖 · 2.62ms 平均耗时 · 18 种预定义样式

description.zh: 一键发布博客到多平台(知乎、掘金、CSDN 等),自动适配 Markdown 方言与图片托管。
description.en: One-click blog publishing across multiple platforms with dialect-aware Markdown and image hosting.

highlights.zh: 多平台同步 · Markdown 方言适配 · 桌面端
highlights.en: Cross-platform sync · Dialect-aware Markdown · Desktop app

description.zh: 思源笔记的分享扩展,让笔记以精致的页面公开分享,支持自定义主题与访问控制。
description.en: A sharing extension for SiYuan Note — publish notes as polished pages with custom themes and access control.

highlights.zh: 思源笔记扩展 · 主题可定制 · 访问控制

description.zh: Windows 上的高性能并行目录删除工具,处理 node_modules 这类深层嵌套目录比原生方式快一个数量级。
description.en: High-performance parallel directory remover for Windows. Handles deeply nested trees like node_modules an order of magnitude faster than native.

highlights.zh: Rust 并行删除 · NTFS 优化 · 符号链接安全
highlights.en: Parallel Rust remover · NTFS-tuned · Symlink safe

description.zh: 探索性的 Agent 编排框架,研究 LLM 作为「写代码的同事」而非玩具的可能性。
description.en: An experimental agent orchestration framework exploring LLMs as coworkers that ship code, not toys.

highlights.zh: Agent 编排 · 工具调用 · 异步工作流
highlights.en: Agent orchestration · Tool calling · Async workflows

description.zh: LSP 中文翻译代理。以透明代理形式插入编辑器与 LSP 进程之间,将 hover、completion、diagnostics 的英文文档实时翻译为中文。
description.en: A transparent LSP proxy that sits between your editor and the LSP server, translating hover / completion / diagnostics from English into Chinese in real time.

highlights.zh: 透明代理 · 支持 VSCode / Neovim / Zed

description.zh: Flutter UI + Rust 核心的多协议下载管理器,支持 HTTP / FTP / BitTorrent 磁力链接与 HLS / DASH 流媒体,覆盖 Windows / macOS / Linux / Android / iOS / Web 全端。AGPL-3.0 开源。
description.en: Multi-protocol download manager with a Flutter UI and Rust core. HTTP / FTP / BitTorrent magnet links plus HLS / DASH streaming, across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

highlights.zh: 全平台 · 多协议 · Rust 核心 · AGPL-3.0
highlights.en: All platforms · Multi-protocol · Rust core · AGPL-3.0

description.zh: 完全去中心化的终端,Warp 的开源社区分支。剥离云端依赖,开放 AI 接入层,支持任意 OpenAI 兼容端点与第三方 CLI Agent,内置 SSH 管理与 tmux 集成,密钥与历史全部留在本地。
description.en: A fully decentralized terminal forked from Warp. Strips cloud dependencies, opens the AI layer to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and third-party CLI agents, ships built-in SSH + tmux management — keys and history stay local.

highlights.zh: BYOP 多 Provider · 第三方 Agent · SSH 内置 · 零云端依赖
highlights.en: BYOP providers · Third-party agents · Built-in SSH · Zero cloud

description.zh: 零知识架构的开源密码管理器。端到端加密,只在本机解密,支持自托管。覆盖桌面端(Wails 3 + Go/React)、浏览器扩展(Chrome / Firefox)与移动端(Expo RN)。
description.en: Zero-knowledge open-source password manager. End-to-end encrypted, decrypted only on your device, self-host friendly. Ships desktop (Wails 3 + Go/React), browser extension (Chrome / Firefox), and mobile (Expo RN).

highlights.zh: 零知识加密 · 跨端 · 自托管 · AGPL-3.0

description.zh: 你正在看的这个站点。Astro + Bun + Tailwind v4,内容源是仓库里的 Markdown,GitHub Actions 构建后 rsync 到自有服务器。
description.en: The site you are reading. Astro + Bun + Tailwind v4, content lives as Markdown in the repo, built by GitHub Actions and rsynced to a self-hosted server.

highlights.zh: Astro 6 · 双语 · 全 SSG · 自建部署
